evidence.evidence_text: Deception is the intentional practice of twisting information.
To encourage further research in this field, we are releasing the SEPSIS dataset and code at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ankurani/deception.

We curated an annotated dataset of 876,784 samples by amalgamating a popular large-scale fake news dataset and scraped news headlines from the Twitter handle of the Times of India, a well-known Indian news media house.
